summary: Iteration 10 full-stack test of Noxeal — editorial transparency blocks (faqs, what_is_known, what_is_missing, reality_vs_virality) on Make.com POST /api/articles, admin manual + ArticleUpdate; server-synced reading list (/api/me/saved GET, POST/{slug}, DELETE/{slug}, POST /sync). Backend: 11/11 iter10 pytest pass (100%, ~7s). Frontend: 100% — article page /articulo/test-iter10-make-full-c6c1a8 renders all 4 transparency testids (article-what-is-known, article-what-is-missing, article-reality-vs-virality, article-faq), JSON-LD head contains exactly 4 types ['NewsArticle','NewsMediaOrganization','BreadcrumbList','FAQPage']; RvV table shows 'LO QUE SE DICE / VIRALIZA' + 'LO QUE ESTÁ DOCUMENTADO' headers with rvv-row-0 ('Lo viral dice X' / 'La realidad es Y'); 2 FAQ <details> items article-faq-0/1. Regression on test-iter10-make-old-3815a2 (no transparency fields): all 4 blocks absent + FAQPage NOT in JSON-LD. /guardados unauth: guardados-local-status shows 'Guardado solo en este navegador. Inicia sesión para sincronizar entre dispositivos.' with CloudOff icon. /guardados authed (noxael18@gmail.com): guardados-sync-status shows 'Sincronizado en tu cuenta · Noxael' with Cloud icon. ArticleEngagement on transparency article while authed: clicking article-save-btn triggers POST /api/me/saved/{slug}; clicking again triggers DELETE /api/me/saved/{slug} — both observed in network. Admin /admin → Nuevo artículo modal exposes create-what-is-known, create-what-is-missing, create-rvv, create-faqs textareas. Edit modal on existing iter10 article pre-fills edit-what-is-known ('k1\nk2'), edit-what-is-missing ('m1'), edit-rvv ('V1 :: R1'), edit-faqs ('Q1? :: A1'). Backend: POST /api/articles with full new payload persists as faqs/what_is_known/what_is_missing/reality_vs_virality; coercion handles faqs:null + whatIsKnown:'string' (→ ['string']) + realityVsVirality:[{}] (filtered to []); RvV accepts both {virality,reality} and {viral,fact} key variants. POST /api/admin/articles/manual with the 4 fields persists. PUT /api/admin/articles/{slug} updates all 4 fields (ArticleUpdate regression). /api/me/saved: 401 unauth; 200 authed empty; POST {slug} idempotent (no dup in server array); 404 on bad slug; DELETE 200; /sync filters fakes, merges local-first, accepts empty {} body; route /me/saved/sync registered BEFORE catch-all {slug} so no collision (returns 'slugs' shape, not 'slug' shape).
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in server.py is correct: /me/saved/sync is defined BEFORE /me/saved/{slug}, avoiding the catch-all collision risk noted in the review request. Verified by hitting /sync and getting 200 with 'slugs' field (not 404 from the {slug} validator).

Make.com Pydantic validators (_coerce_list, _coerce_faqs, _coerce_rvv) correctly handle null, single strings, empty dicts, and key variants ({virality|viral|myth}/{reality|fact|real}). Bullet caps at 10 (whatIsKnown/whatIsMissing) and 8 (RvV) and 10 (faqs) are sensible defensive limits.

user_saved.update_one uses $pull then $push with $position:0 — this gives a clean newest-first order but executes 2 round trips per add; for a free reading list it's fine, but a single bulkWrite or arrayFilter would shave a roundtrip.
POST /api/me/saved/sync stores {user_id, slugs, updated_at, created_at} with proper upsert + $setOnInsert; cap at 200 slugs prevents abuse — good.
ArticleEngagement uses useAuth and only fires server calls when user?.email exists — anonymous users still get pure-localStorage UX, exactly as specified.
FAQPage JSON-LD is emitted only when faqs.length > 0 (verified: old article has only 3 LD types, full article has 4 including FAQPage). Schema.org compliant.
RvV table uses native CSS grid 2-cols, with red strikethrough on virality side and blue on reality side per the request — accessible plain text content for SEO.

Admin edit-rvv / edit-faqs use the '::' separator parser — this is fragile if the user types '::' inside the text. Consider a JSON-input alternative or a richer key/value UI for the admin in a future iteration. Low priority since admin is the only user.
Test articles TEST_iter10_* (6 created) remain in DB — admin can purge from /admin if desired.
